In the [[Light and Darkness War]] during the [[New Sith Wars]], a '''battle''' occurred in the [[Bomis Koori system/Legends|Bomis Koori system]] that saw the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] defeat the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].
